'''2011 Yavin 4 Regionals Casey Anis LS We'll Handle This''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Casey Anis]] at [[2011 Yavin 4 Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|We'll Handle This / Duel Of The Fates|Ref3-L-wellhandlethis.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' LS Combat v3.3
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
